verdict.rationale: Runpod documents creating Pods from the console, CLI (`runpodctl pod create`), the REST API v1 and GraphQL, and promises to "run code on a remote GPU in minutes" with ready-to-go templates. A runtime probe confirms the REST API is live and key-gated, and community users describe deploying templates "in a few clicks". One hands-on report of 4090 low-availability messages and failed boots tempers the "within minutes" promise but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: independent measurement of time-to-running-code, and evidence of consistent GPU availability at provision time.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision an on-demand GPU instance from the console or API and be running code on it within minutes
